_doc: The bots' utility AI (Update 03 section 1; gravelight/bots/bot_utility.gd scores, bot_actions.gd runs them). Every think (think_hz, staggered across bots) each action scores weight x the product of its considerations (each an input from _inputs through a curve from curves.json or inline; the product is compensated for the number of considerations, the usual IAUS make-up), x the personality's action weight (personality_<char>.json actions), x the role's (roles), + an active order's boost (orders), + gaussian decision noise (skills.json decision_noise), + hysteresis for the action already running (+ commit_bonus while it is mid-task: holding a revive, a buy, a repair). The highest wins. Tuning here never needs a code change.

_inputs.mag: magazine fraction of the gun in hand
_inputs.mag_reserve: 1 when the gun in hand has reserve ammo
_inputs.any_ammo: 1 when any carried gun has ammo
_inputs.armed: 1 when it carries a firearm (Jakub unarmed: 0)
_inputs.pressure: threat pressure (perception), sum of nearby threat / pressure_norm
_inputs.near: nearest known zombie / 20 m (1 = none within 20 m)
_inputs.sprinter_close: 1 when a sprinter is within 4 m
_inputs.has_target: 1 when the aim layer has a visible target
_inputs.revive_mine: 1 when this bot holds a revive claim
_inputs.revive_bleed: the claimed downed teammate's bleed-out left / full
_inputs.revive_blocked: 1 when a sprinter is within 6 m of the downed one and more than 10 s are left (under 8 s it is always 0: go anyway)
_inputs.revive_path: path length to the downed one / 30 m
_inputs.revive_speed: 2 / revive seconds (Second Wind halves the hold), clamped
_inputs.cover_need: 1 when this bot covers a revive (cover claim), or its own revive is blocked
_inputs.leader_far: distance to the leader / 20 m (0 when it leads)
_inputs.squad_far: distance to the nearest standing teammate / 20 m
_inputs.loop: 1 when a training route (or the free kite loop) is usable here
_inputs.hold_spot: 1 when it has a spot to hold (a Hold order, or a window pair in the early rounds)
_inputs.repair_task: value of the best barricade to rebuild (0 none)
_inputs.buy_task: value of the best purchase (bot_economy.gd, 0 none)
_inputs.crate_task: value of a Requisition Crate pull (0 none)
_inputs.resupply_task: value of an ammo box / wall ammo for the main gun (0 none; 1 when nearly dry)
_inputs.resupply_ammo: the ammo fraction of the gun the resupply candidate refills (the fullest long gun when there is none; QA Q-05)
_inputs.powerup_task: value of a power-up it may take (etiquette, 0 none)
_inputs.trap_task: value of a trap it may pull (only when ordered or the player used it, 0 none)
_inputs.chatter_ok: 1 when a chatter line is off cooldown
_inputs.objective: 1 when the local-AI planner has a directive for it
_inputs.ee_task: the value of its easter-egg task (BotEE.value, ee.json value: 0 when it has none, it is paused or waiting; T-067)
_inputs.order: strength of an order with its own task (open a door, fetch a part)
_inputs.mark_order: the value of its map-mark order (BotMarkTask.value, marks.json value: 0 with none, while it waits for Scrip, or for an easter-egg mark: BotEE runs that one; T-069)
_inputs.escort_far: distance to the escorted player / 15 m
_inputs.stand_fast: 1 in a special round (the Bellringers: too fast to run from; T-058): stand together and shoot
_inputs.trainer: the player bot's training value (BotTrainer.value, T-071): 0 for every other brain, without a loop or a round; 1 with zombies about; player_bot.json trainer.calm_value when nothing is near

roles._doc: Squad roles (Update 03 section 5), assigned by BotSquad every roles_every_s from the personalities' role_bias: each role's action multipliers.

orders._doc: Command wheel orders (bots.json commands.orders): each is a high-weight boost for `duration_s` (60) or until done. boost adds to an action's score, mult multiplies it.
